item.text: {"reviews":[{"benchmark":"arc","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The public ARC-AGI-2 test, official scoring software and verified-testing rules are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Rule inference, AI comparisons and broader reasoning claims are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Example grid pairs, new inputs and required complete output grids are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The passage describes two attempts per input and specified settings and spending limits for verified tests."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Exact grid matching, averaging within problems and averaging across problems are explained."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Inferring rules from examples is explicitly linked to reasoning on unfamiliar problems."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Puzzle origins, human difficulty testing and duplicate-rule removal support selection, but broader representativeness is unestablished."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Developer review and documented corrections show checking; comprehensive reference-answer validation is not described."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The puzzles address rule inference and combining ideas, but evidence covers only two-dimensional grids."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Exact matching measures successful grid completion, but does not establish which reasoning process produced it."},{"id":11,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The averaging procedure is explicit, but its interpretation as a broader ability measure is not established."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public marking tests cover several correct and incorrect output cases; full marking-system validation is not established."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"AI results and human difficulty data provide context, but human results cover a larger pool than the final test."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Verified testing uses one run, and no repeated-run study of AI score variation is supplied."},{"id":15,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No systematic study of changes to instructions, grid presentation or software is supplied."},{"id":16,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"The reviewed materials provide no estimates or ranges for repeated-test score variation."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Design checks address program search and repeated rules, without establishing that all unintended routes were investigated."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Hidden-test handling agreements and exposure monitoring address risk, while public exposure and possible leaks remain."},{"id":19,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Development training is allowed, evaluation-specific adaptation is discouraged, and verified feedback is restricted to preserve evaluation separation."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No supplied study connects scores to language, social interaction or real-world work."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Verified settings are recorded and test sets are matched for human difficulty, but other testing routes differ."},{"id":22,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public problems, running software and marking tests support inspection and repetition of the scoped public evaluation."},{"id":23,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Public licensing and hidden-data confidentiality, provider-handling and selected-submission review rules are stated."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Dated corrections and exact code changes are recorded, but affected AI scores are not all recalculated."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Grid-solving comparisons have direct support; connections to broader intelligence lack corresponding evidence here."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire usefully separates scoring descriptions, validation and broader claims. Several items combine conditions: selection and answer checks, marking accuracy and consistency, or access and reuse protections. Partial evidence therefore needs comments. Human difficulty matching must be distinguished from AI score stability, and public evaluations from hidden verified tests.","supported_claims":["The benchmark measures successful completion of unfamiliar grid outputs under specified conditions.","Official software permits partial problem credit when only some new inputs are solved.","Human studies informed selection of test sets with similar human difficulty."],"documented_problems":["The software's fractional problem scores differ from the dataset's definition of a fully solved problem.","Corrections include coloured squares and unclear examples.","Revision records do not recalculate every affected AI score."],"missing_information":["Repeated-run score variation and sensitivity to testing changes.","Evidence predicting performance beyond grid puzzles.","Comprehensive validation of the marking system and reference answers."],"reinterpretations":["Treat scores as grid-completion performance under the stated testing route.","Interpret matched human difficulty as a property of set selection, not evidence of stable AI scores.","Distinguish average input success within problems from the proportion of fully solved problems."],"closing_note":"The questionnaire does not define how much evidence makes a combined condition fully supported. 'Condition-native review' is also undefined; it is interpreted here as a review of questionnaire fit and clarity for this benchmark."},{"benchmark":"designqa","mesa_answers":[{"id":1,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The original 2024 benchmark, 1,451 question pairs and public scoring software are identified."},{"id":2,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Engineering rule retrieval, drawing understanding, application tasks and intended AI comparisons are described."},{"id":3,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Six task groups, supplied rules and images, and required text or yes/no responses are described."},{"id":4,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Instructions and settings are described, but exact historical inputs and settings are not fully linked to every result."},{"id":5,"choice":"Yes","comment":"Text similarity, yes/no credit and equal weighting of the six groups are described."},{"id":6,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors link the tasks to parts of engineering work involving documents and designs."},{"id":7,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Practical materials and practitioner contributions support relevance, but one rulebook and uneven groups limit coverage."},{"id":8,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Additional reviewers checked manually written questions, with exceptions and more limited checks of some explanations."},{"id":9,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Six groups cover several relevant activities, but only a limited range of engineering tasks and materials."},{"id":10,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Correct decisions receive credit, but wording, formatting and incomplete reference answers can affect marks."},{"id":11,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Equal group weighting is described, but evidence supporting that combination or distinct skill interpretations is not supplied."},{"id":12,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Small marking tests and discussion of scoring problems show checking, without a complete accuracy and consistency study."},{"id":13,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Random guessing and other AI systems provide context, but information supplies differ and no human-engineer baseline is reported."},{"id":14,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Five passage sets change the supplied information and therefore do not establish identical-condition repeatability."},{"id":15,"choice":"Yes","comment":"The authors examine changes to passages, dimension labels, scale bars and image highlighting."},{"id":16,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Passage-set variation supplies some evidence, but uncertainty is insufficient for confident small differences in the main comparisons."},{"id":17,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Formatting, retrieval and component familiarity are examined, but unintended scoring routes are not fully tested."},{"id":18,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Image novelty and possible exposure are discussed, but systematic overlap checks and a protected test set are not established."},{"id":19,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"Clear rules on test-specific training and repeated submissions were unavailable in the reviewed sources."},{"id":20,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"No evidence establishes prediction of success on other technical documents or engineering projects."},{"id":21,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Testing conditions are described, but systems receive different information, complicating comparisons of their abilities."},{"id":22,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Public materials support inspection, but exact historical software, settings and inputs are incompletely linked to results."},{"id":23,"choice":"Not sure","comment":"A licence file and complete responsible-reuse rules were not found; this does not establish that reuse is prohibited."},{"id":24,"choice":"Partly","comment":"Code history identifies revisions, but a clear account of their effects on scores was not found."},{"id":25,"choice":"Partly","comment":"The paper acknowledges important limits, while broad engineering interpretations and fine ranking distinctions remain insufficiently supported."}],"instrument_review":"The questionnaire distinguishes documented scoring weaknesses from missing validation. Its broad conditions need comments to preserve differences between six task groups and marking methods. Repeated runs must mean identical conditions: changing retrieved passages tests setup sensitivity. Missing licensing or training policies warrant uncertainty, not a finding that permission or policies do not exist.","supported_claims":["The benchmark examines six types of questions grounded in Formula SAE materials.","Results describe AI systems together with their supplied information and scoring methods.","The authors tested sensitivity to several changes in passages and visual presentation."],"documented_problems":["Wording and formatting can change credit, including valid related rules missing from reference answers.","Question groups are highly uneven, while the overall score weights them equally.","All described scale-bar drawings comply, allowing an always-yes strategy to earn their decision credit.","One released answer file has fewer rows than the corresponding paper question count."],"missing_information":["Identical-condition repeated-run variation and adequate uncertainty for close comparisons.","Complete marking validation and remaining reference-answer error rates.","Evidence of transfer to other documents or real engineering projects.","Complete historical reproduction records, reuse rules and test-specific training policies."],"reinterpretations":["Read results as performance on these tasks with the supplied rule passages, images and marking rules.","Treat the overall score as an equally weighted combination of groups, without assuming it measures one distinct skill.","Recognize the always-yes opportunity without claiming any tested AI used it."],"closing_note":"The questionnaire leaves the required strength of evidence unclear for combined conditions and broad claims. 'Condition-native review' is undefined; it is interpreted here as a review of questionnaire fit and clarity for this benchmark."}]}
